contexts.context: ...of Spain? Where are the Gothic Chiefs Sacaru, <mark>Theudemir</mark>, Athanagild, All who survivd that days obstinate fight...
...not ask Of things so long gone by. Athanagild And <mark>Theudemir</mark> have taken on their necks The yoke. Sacaru playd...
...no one break These shameful fetters? – Pedro! <mark>Theudemir</mark>! Athanagild! where are ye? – Rodericks arm...
